subject: Every string the arrange.regions surface exposes to AX in zh-CN
question: What labels does Logic show on arrange.regions in zh-CN, and on which elements?

reverify.expected: a census in zh-CN whose arrange.regions rows carry the same 20 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading
reverify.cost: ~1 min with Logic open on the fixture project in that locale

method: Read, never actuated. The menu bar and every menu were walked without opening them; the main window was walked to depth 8. Each element with any string became one row of the evidence file; rows were assigned to this surface by what their path or help text passes through, and rows no rule could place are counted in limits rather than filed.

strings: 工作区. 录音、编辑和编配音频、MIDI 片段和伴奏乐手片段的首选区域，被分为不同的轨道类型。
循环区域. 重复播放或录制黄色条中的项目部分。拖移该条以移动范围，或拖移其边缘以编辑长度。
播放头. 表示播放位置。通过拖移、点按标尺下部进行移动，或使用 LCD 位置显示。
片段开始于 1 小节 ，结束于 2 小节 , MIDI 片段. 包含 MIDI 音符和控制器事件。拖移其中间以移动，拖移下边缘以调整大小，拖移右上边缘以循环。使用此工具以执行其他编辑操作。
项目开始标记. 表示项目开始点。向左拖移在第一个强拍之前播放弱拍或音色变化命令。
项目结束标记. 表示项目结束点。录音时，标记会移动以适合项目长度。垂直拖移以更改位置。

conclusion: On this host in zh-CN, arrange.regions exposes 16 elements carrying 20 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Navigation-free surfaces only: nothing behind a menu press or a button was opened, so this says nothing about the mixer, plug-in editors or the editors.

9 window-level rows (the title bar, its close/minimise/zoom buttons and the unnamed containers directly under the window) belong to no area and are filed under no record; 0 further window rows matched no area rule. All are in the evidence file.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.
